text: 临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归
pinyin: lín xíng mì mì féng, yì kǒng chí chí guī
literal: about to · leave · close · close · sew, intent · fear · slow · slow · return
natural: As he is about to leave she sews stitch upon close stitch, fearing he will be slow to come home

meaning.en: A mother's love shown in tiny acts as her son leaves; quoted on Mother's Day and in praise of maternal love.
meaning.zh: 母亲在儿子远行前一针一线缝衣，担心他迟迟不归，常在母亲节等场合赞颂母爱。

equivalents: a mother's stitches, a mother's love
a mother's love in every stitch

examples.zh: 母亲节，他在贺卡上写下“临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归”。
examples.en: On Mother's Day he wrote '临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归' on the card.

examples.zh: 读到“临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归”，我想起母亲缝的那件棉衣。
examples.en: Reading '临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归', I thought of the padded coat my mother sewed.

story.en: Meng Jiao wrote 'Song of the Wandering Son' after finally taking a minor post in Liyang in his fifties and bringing his mother to live with him.
story.zh: 孟郊年过半百才得任溧阳县尉，迎母同住，作《游子吟》。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 只在此山中，云深不知处
pinyin: zhǐ zài cǐ shān zhōng, yún shēn bù zhī chù
literal: only · is · this · mountain · in, clouds · deep · not · know · whereabouts
natural: He is somewhere in these mountains, but the clouds are deep and I don't know where

meaning.en: The master is nearby but out of reach; quoted when someone elusive cannot be found.
meaning.zh: 隐者就在山中，却云深难寻，常用来形容想找的人近在咫尺却无处寻觅。

equivalents: somewhere in these hills, but hidden by clouds
so close yet hard to find

examples.zh: 他躲在家里不接电话，真是“只在此山中，云深不知处”。
examples.en: He hides at home and won't answer his phone: '只在此山中，云深不知处'.

examples.zh: 山中寻访高人，只得“只在此山中，云深不知处”。
examples.en: Seeking a sage in the mountains, all I got was '只在此山中，云深不知处'.

story.en: A quatrain in which a visitor asks a boy where his master, a hermit, has gone to gather herbs; this is the boy's reply. (Some collections attribute it to Sun Ge.)
story.zh: 诗中童子回答来访者：师父采药去了，只在此山中。（一说作者为孙革。）

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新
pinyin: wèi chéng zhāo yǔ yì qīng chén, kè shè qīng qīng liǔ sè xīn
literal: Weicheng · morning · rain · dampen · light · dust, inn · green · green · willow · colour · fresh
natural: Morning rain in Weicheng has settled the light dust; the inn is green, green, and the willows look fresh

meaning.en: The opening of the famed farewell poem, a clean, fresh scene before a parting; quoted at partings.
meaning.zh: 送别诗的开头，雨后清新的景色衬托即将离别，常在送别时引用。

equivalents: a fresh, rain-washed farewell
a willow-green parting

examples.zh: 机场送别，他轻声念起“渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新”。
examples.en: At the airport farewell he quietly recited '渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新'.

examples.zh: 毕业季，朋友圈里全是“渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新”。
examples.en: At graduation season, feeds were full of '渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新'.

story.en: Wang Wei bade farewell to his friend Yuan Er, sent on a mission to Anxi in the far west; the poem was set to music as 'Yangguan Song'.
story.zh: 王维送友人元二出使安西，后被谱为《阳关三叠》。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 明月松间照，清泉石上流
pinyin: míng yuè sōng jiān zhào, qīng quán shí shàng liú
literal: bright · moon · pines · among · shines, clear · spring · rocks · over · flows
natural: The bright moon shines among the pines; a clear spring flows over the rocks

meaning.en: A tranquil mountain scene of moonlight and water; quoted as a model of poetic imagery or for a peaceful retreat.
meaning.zh: 描写山间月夜幽静之景，是写景佳句，常用来形容宁静的山居生活。

equivalents: moonlight through pines, a spring on the rocks
a perfectly peaceful mountain night

examples.zh: 民宿的名字叫“明月松间照，清泉石上流”。
examples.en: The guesthouse is named '明月松间照，清泉石上流'.

examples.zh: 夜宿山中，才懂“明月松间照，清泉石上流”的清幽。
examples.en: Staying the night in the mountains, I understood the serenity of '明月松间照，清泉石上流'.

story.en: From Wang Wei's 'Autumn Evening in the Mountains', a poem about his retreat at Wangchuan.
story.zh: 出自王维描写辋川隐居生活的《山居秋暝》。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 愿君多采撷，此物最相思
pinyin: yuàn jūn duō cǎi xié, cǐ wù zuì xiāng sī
literal: wish · you · more · pick, this · thing · most · longing
natural: I wish you would gather more of them; this is the thing that best stirs longing

meaning.en: Red beans symbolise longing; quoted to express missing someone or as a token of affection.
meaning.zh: 红豆象征相思，常用来表达思念，或作为情意的寄托。

equivalents: red beans mean missing you
a token of longing

examples.zh: 他送了一包红豆，附言“愿君多采撷，此物最相思”。
examples.en: He sent a bag of red beans with the note '愿君多采撷，此物最相思'.

examples.zh: 情人节的卡片上写着“愿君多采撷，此物最相思”。
examples.en: The Valentine's card says '愿君多采撷，此物最相思'.

story.en: The poem's first lines ask about red beans growing in the south; these closing lines wish the friend to gather them as tokens of longing.
story.zh: 诗前两句写红豆生南国，此二句嘱对方多采红豆以寄相思。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 人闲桂花落，夜静春山空
pinyin: rén xián guì huā luò, yè jìng chūn shān kōng
literal: people · idle · osmanthus · flowers · fall, night · quiet · spring · mountain · empty
natural: With no one about, osmanthus blossoms fall; the night is still and the spring mountain empty

meaning.en: A peaceful, almost Zen scene of stillness; quoted for tranquillity and inner calm.
meaning.zh: 宁静得近乎禅意的境界，常用来形容心境闲适、环境幽静。

equivalents: the stillness of a spring night in the hills
peace so deep the flowers fall unheard

examples.zh: 静坐片刻，体会“人闲桂花落，夜静春山空”的意境。
examples.en: Sitting still for a moment, I felt the spirit of '人闲桂花落，夜静春山空'.

examples.zh: 民宿门口挂着“人闲桂花落，夜静春山空”。
examples.en: '人闲桂花落，夜静春山空' hangs at the guesthouse door.

story.en: The opening of Wang Wei's 'Bird-Song Brook', one of the 'Wangchuan Collection' poems.
story.zh: 王维《鸟鸣涧》的开头，属《辋川集》一类的山水诗。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 气蒸云梦泽，波撼岳阳城
pinyin: qì zhēng yún mèng zé, bō hàn yuè yáng chéng
literal: vapour · steams · Yunmeng · marsh, waves · shake · Yueyang · city
natural: Mist steams over Yunmeng Marsh; waves shake the city of Yueyang

meaning.en: A vast, powerful view of Dongting Lake; quoted for grand scenery and mighty momentum.
meaning.zh: 描写洞庭湖水势浩大的景象，常用来形容气势磅礴。

equivalents: mist over the great marsh, waves against the city
majestic lake scenery

examples.zh: 站在岳阳楼上，眼前正是“气蒸云梦泽，波撼岳阳城”。
examples.en: Standing on Yueyang Tower, what I saw was '气蒸云梦泽，波撼岳阳城'.

examples.zh: 解说词引用“气蒸云梦泽，波撼岳阳城”形容洞庭湖。
examples.en: The commentary quoted '气蒸云梦泽，波撼岳阳城' to describe Dongting Lake.

origin.source: 孟浩然《望洞庭湖赠张丞相》

story.en: Meng Haoran wrote this to Prime Minister Zhang Jiuling, hoping for a recommendation to office.
story.zh: 孟浩然赠宰相张九龄之作，含求荐引之意。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 绿树村边合，青山郭外斜
pinyin: lǜ shù cūn biān hé, qīng shān guō wài xié
literal: green · trees · village · edge · close in, green · hills · outer wall · outside · slope
natural: Green trees close in around the village edge; green hills slope beyond the town wall

meaning.en: A peaceful pastoral scene; quoted for rural charm.
meaning.zh: 宁静的田园风光，常用来形容乡村景色。

equivalents: trees around the village, hills beyond
peaceful countryside

examples.zh: 坐火车穿过乡间，窗外是“绿树村边合，青山郭外斜”。
examples.en: On the train through the countryside, outside the window was '绿树村边合，青山郭外斜'.

examples.zh: 旅游宣传片用“绿树村边合，青山郭外斜”配画面。
examples.en: The travel video used '绿树村边合，青山郭外斜' as the caption.

story.en: Meng Haoran visits an old friend's farm; the poem describes a simple country dinner.
story.zh: 写孟浩然应邀到老友农庄做客，共享田家饭菜。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 待到重阳日，还来就菊花
pinyin: dài dào chóng yáng rì, huán lái jiù jú huā
literal: wait · till · Double Ninth · day, again · come · approach · chrysanthemums
natural: When the Double Ninth comes, I will return to enjoy the chrysanthemums

meaning.en: A promise to visit a friend again; quoted for invitations and appointments, especially at the Double Ninth Festival.
meaning.zh: 约定重阳再来赏菊，常用来表示再次拜访的约定，尤其在重阳节引用。

equivalents: I'll be back for the chrysanthemum festival
a promise to return

examples.zh: 临别时他说“待到重阳日，还来就菊花”。
examples.en: At parting he said '待到重阳日，还来就菊花'.

examples.zh: 重阳节，老友聚会时又念起“待到重阳日，还来就菊花”。
examples.en: At the Double Ninth old friends gathered and again recited '待到重阳日，还来就菊花'.

story.en: The closing lines of the poem, where the guest promises his friend to come back at the Double Ninth Festival.
story.zh: 该诗结尾，宾客约定重阳节再来赏菊。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 移舟泊烟渚，日暮客愁新
pinyin: yí zhōu bó yān zhǔ, rì mù kè chóu xīn
literal: move · boat · moor · misty · islet, sun · dusk · traveller's · sorrow · new
natural: I move my boat to moor at a misty islet; at sunset a traveller's sorrow rises afresh

meaning.en: Dusk intensifies the homesickness of a traveller; quoted for loneliness on the road.
meaning.zh: 暮色中旅人的乡愁又起，常用来形容羁旅孤寂。

equivalents: dusk brings fresh homesickness
a traveller's evening sorrow

examples.zh: 夜宿异乡，想起“移舟泊烟渚，日暮客愁新”。
examples.en: Staying the night in a strange town, I thought of '移舟泊烟渚，日暮客愁新'.

examples.zh: 出差第三天，他发了一句“移舟泊烟渚，日暮客愁新”。
examples.en: On the third day of his business trip he posted '移舟泊烟渚，日暮客愁新'.

story.en: Meng Haoran wrote this while travelling and mooring his boat at the Jiande River in Zhejiang.
story.zh: 孟浩然旅途泊舟浙江建德江时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 野旷天低树，江清月近人
pinyin: yě kuàng tiān dī shù, jiāng qīng yuè jìn rén
literal: plain · wide · sky · low · trees, river · clear · moon · near · people
natural: The plain is wide and the sky hangs low over the trees; the river is clear and the moon draws near

meaning.en: A scene so wide that the sky meets the trees and the moon seems close; quoted for expansive night scenery and quiet company.
meaning.zh: 旷野无边、天低树矮、江月近人，常用来形容辽阔而静谧的夜景。

equivalents: the sky meets the trees, the moon is near
a vast, quiet night

examples.zh: 湖边夜宿，只觉“野旷天低树，江清月近人”。
examples.en: Camping by the lake at night, all I felt was '野旷天低树，江清月近人'.

examples.zh: 语文老师带大家赏析“野旷天低树，江清月近人”的炼字。
examples.en: The teacher led a close study of the diction in '野旷天低树，江清月近人'.

story.en: The second couplet of the same poem; the vastness contrasts with the poet's loneliness.
story.zh: 同诗的后两句，辽阔的景象反衬诗人的孤寂。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山
pinyin: dàn shǐ lóng chéng fēi jiàng zài, bù jiào hú mǎ dù yīn shān
literal: if only · Dragon City · Flying General · were present, not · let · Hu · horses · cross · Yin · Mountains
natural: If only the Flying General of Dragon City were here, no barbarian horse would cross the Yin Mountains

meaning.en: A cry for a great commander to defend the frontier; quoted to wish for capable leaders or to praise brave defenders.
meaning.zh: 呼唤名将守边、不让外敌入侵，常用来盼望能人坐镇或赞美英勇的守卫者。

equivalents: if only a true general were here
we need a leader like that

examples.zh: 球队危难之时，球迷高喊“但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山”。
examples.en: In the team's hour of need, fans cried '但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山'.

examples.zh: “但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山”，大家盼望一位好领导。
examples.en: '但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山': everyone longs for a good leader.

story.en: The 'Flying General' is generally taken to be Li Guang of the Han (or Wei Qing, the general of Dragon City); Wang Changling contrasts him with the generals of his own day.
story.zh: “龙城飞将”一般指汉代名将李广（一说卫青），王昌龄借以慨叹当世缺少良将。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回
pinyin: zuì wò shā chǎng jūn mò xiào, gǔ lái zhēng zhàn jǐ rén huí
literal: drunk · lie · battlefield · you · don't · laugh, ancient · times · campaign · war · how many · people · return
natural: Don't laugh if I lie drunk on the battlefield; since ancient times how many have come back from war?

meaning.en: A soldier's bold, bitter humour about the danger of war; quoted for fatalistic daring and for letting go.
meaning.zh: 边塞将士豪放又悲凉的自嘲，常用来表示豁出去的洒脱与对战争的感慨。

equivalents: who knows if we'll come back from war?
drink up, for tomorrow we may not return

examples.zh: 聚会上他举杯笑说“醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回”。
examples.en: At the party he raised his glass and laughed '醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回'.

examples.zh: 读到“醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回”，才懂边塞诗的悲壮。
examples.en: Reading '醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回', I understood the stirring tragedy of frontier poems.

story.en: From the Tang poet Wang Han's 'Liangzhou Song', a banquet scene before departing for the frontier.
story.zh: 唐代王翰《凉州词》，写出征前宴饮的场景。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 羌笛何须怨杨柳，春风不度玉门关
pinyin: qiāng dí hé xū yuàn yáng liǔ, chūn fēng bù dù yù mén guān
literal: Qiang · flute · why · need · lament · willows, spring · wind · not · cross · Jade Gate · Pass
natural: Why should the Qiang flute lament the willows? The spring wind never crosses Jade Gate Pass

meaning.en: Frontier desolation: willows do not grow beyond the pass, so there is nothing to lament; quoted for the bleakness of remote places.
meaning.zh: 边塞荒凉，春风不到，连杨柳也不生，常用来形容偏远苦寒之地。

equivalents: spring never reaches the frontier
desolation beyond the pass

examples.zh: 驻守边关的战士感叹“羌笛何须怨杨柳，春风不度玉门关”。
examples.en: The soldier at the frontier sighed '羌笛何须怨杨柳，春风不度玉门关'.

examples.zh: 沙漠中的小镇，真是“羌笛何须怨杨柳，春风不度玉门关”。
examples.en: A town in the desert: truly '羌笛何须怨杨柳，春风不度玉门关'.

story.en: Wang Zhihuan's quatrain on the remote Liangzhou frontier; 折杨柳 was a custom of giving willow at partings, and the Qiang flute played the song 'Breaking the Willow'.
story.zh: 王之涣《凉州词》，写边塞荒凉；“折杨柳”是离别赠柳之俗，羌笛吹奏《折杨柳》曲。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船
pinyin: gū sū chéng wài hán shān sì, yè bàn zhōng shēng dào kè chuán
literal: Gusu · city · outside · Hanshan · Temple, night · half · bell · sound · reaches · traveller's · boat
natural: Outside Gusu city lies Hanshan Temple; its midnight bell reaches the traveller's boat

meaning.en: A famed image of a night bell heard by a traveller; quoted for Suzhou's Hanshan Temple and for lonely night travel.
meaning.zh: 夜半钟声传到客船的名句，成为苏州寒山寺的象征，也用于形容旅人夜宿的孤寂。

equivalents: the midnight bell at Hanshan Temple
a traveller's night sleepless to the bell

examples.zh: 每年除夕，寒山寺都会敲响“姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船”的钟声。
examples.en: Each New Year's Eve the bell of Hanshan Temple, '姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船', is struck.

examples.zh: 游客在寒山寺门前拍照，背景是“姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船”。
examples.en: Tourists photograph themselves at Hanshan Temple with '姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船' behind them.

story.en: Zhang Ji wrote 'Mooring at Maple Bridge at Night' after failing the imperial exam, or fleeing the An Lushan rebellion, and stopping at Suzhou.
story.zh: 张继落第或避安史之乱途经苏州，夜泊枫桥时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 念天地之悠悠，独怆然而涕下
pinyin: niàn tiān dì zhī yōu yōu, dú chuàng rán ér tì xià
literal: think · heaven · earth · [of] · boundless, alone · sorrowful · -ly · and · tears · fall
natural: Thinking of the boundless heaven and earth, alone I weep in sorrow

meaning.en: The loneliness of an unrecognised talent facing the vastness of time and space; quoted for existential solitude.
meaning.zh: 面对天地与时间的广阔，怀才不遇者的孤独悲怆，常用来表达深沉的孤寂。

equivalents: alone before the vastness of time and space
an unappreciated talent's lament

examples.zh: 站在山顶，他忽然想起“念天地之悠悠，独怆然而涕下”。
examples.en: Standing on the summit he suddenly recalled '念天地之悠悠，独怆然而涕下'.

examples.zh: 论文开头用“念天地之悠悠，独怆然而涕下”，渲染了孤独感。
examples.en: The thesis opens with '念天地之悠悠，独怆然而涕下', conveying loneliness.

story.en: Chen Zi'ang climbed Youzhou Terrace around 696 after his advice to a commander was ignored, and wrote this song.
story.zh: 696年前后陈子昂随军征战，进谏不被采纳，登幽州台作此歌。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 江畔何人初见月，江月何年初照人
pinyin: jiāng pàn hé rén chū jiàn yuè, jiāng yuè hé nián chū zhào rén
literal: river · bank · what · person · first · saw · moon, river · moon · what · year · first · shone on · people
natural: Who by the river first saw the moon? In what year did the river moon first shine on people?

meaning.en: A philosophical question about human life and the endless moon; quoted when contemplating time and existence.
meaning.zh: 对宇宙与人生的追问：谁最先见到月亮，月亮又何时开始照人，常用来感叹时间悠远。

equivalents: who first saw the moon?
a question of time and existence

examples.zh: 对着满月，他问起“江畔何人初见月，江月何年初照人”。
examples.en: Looking at the full moon, he asked '江畔何人初见月，江月何年初照人'.

examples.zh: “江畔何人初见月，江月何年初照人”，这是诗里最有哲思的一问。
examples.en: '江畔何人初见月，江月何年初照人': the most philosophical question in the poem.

story.en: From a famous long poem by the early-Tang poet Zhang Ruoxu, praised by Wen Yiduo as 'the poem above all poems'.
story.zh: 初唐张若虚的长诗，被闻一多誉为“诗中的诗，顶峰上的顶峰”。

date.zh: 唐 · 约7世纪末—8世纪初

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然
pinyin: cǐ qíng kě dài chéng zhuī yì, zhǐ shì dāng shí yǐ wǎng rán
literal: this · feeling · may · wait · to become · memory, only · was · at that time · already · bewildered
natural: This feeling could become a memory to look back on, but at the time I was already lost in bewilderment

meaning.en: We only feel the weight of a moment later; quoted for regret over feelings or chances that went unappreciated.
meaning.zh: 当时不觉珍贵，事后才知怅惘，常用来感叹错过的感情和时光。

equivalents: we didn't realise at the time
only in hindsight do we see its worth

examples.zh: 毕业多年，回想起来真是“此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然”。
examples.en: Many years after graduation, it really is '此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然'.

examples.zh: 影片结尾配上“此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然”。
examples.en: The film ends with '此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然'.

story.en: Li Shangyin's famously obscure 'Ornamented Zither'; interpretations range from a lament for his late wife to a reflection on his whole life.
story.zh: 李商隐《锦瑟》，主旨历来多解，或说悼亡，或说自伤身世。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时
pinyin: hé dāng gòng jiǎn xī chuāng zhú, què huà bā shān yè yǔ shí
literal: when · will · together · trim · west · window · candle, then · talk · Bashan · night · rain · time
natural: When shall we trim the candle together at the west window and talk of this night of rain in the Ba hills?

meaning.en: Longing to be reunited and to tell of present hardship; quoted for reunions and nostalgic anticipation.
meaning.zh: 盼望重逢时共话今日夜雨思念，常用来表达对团聚的期盼。

equivalents: when we meet again, we'll talk of this night
longing for a reunion

examples.zh: 出差在外，他给妻子发了一句“何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时”。
examples.en: Away on business, he texted his wife '何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时'.

examples.zh: 毕业后，我们约好“何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时”。
examples.en: After graduation we agreed: '何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时'.

story.en: Li Shangyin, in Sichuan, writes to a loved one in the north (a wife or friend) on a rainy night, imagining a future reunion.
story.zh: 李商隐在巴蜀夜雨中寄给北方亲人（妻或友），遥想日后重逢共话。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 南朝四百八十寺，多少楼台烟雨中
pinyin: nán cháo sì bǎi bā shí sì, duō shǎo lóu tái yān yǔ zhōng
literal: Southern · Dynasties · four · hundred · eighty · temples, how many · towers · terraces · mist · rain · in
natural: The Southern Dynasties built four hundred and eighty temples; how many towers and terraces stand in the misty rain

meaning.en: A hazy, grand image of the lost Buddhist world of the Southern Dynasties; quoted for misty rain on Jiangnan and the passing of eras.
meaning.zh: 烟雨中的江南寺庙，兼有历史沧桑感，常用来形容江南烟雨和朝代更替。

equivalents: temples in the misty rain of Jiangnan
the lost splendour of the Southern Dynasties

examples.zh: 清明时节游南京，眼前如“南朝四百八十寺，多少楼台烟雨中”。
examples.en: Visiting Nanjing at Qingming, the scene was just like '南朝四百八十寺，多少楼台烟雨中'.

examples.zh: 摄影师用“南朝四百八十寺，多少楼台烟雨中”做展览标题。
examples.en: The photographer used '南朝四百八十寺，多少楼台烟雨中' as his exhibition title.

story.en: Du Mu wrote this as an official in Jiangnan, alluding to Emperor Wu of Liang and the many Buddhist temples of the Southern Dynasties.
story.zh: 杜牧在江南为官时所作，指南朝梁武帝等崇佛、广建寺庙之事。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 借问酒家何处有，牧童遥指杏花村
pinyin: jiè wèn jiǔ jiā hé chù yǒu, mù tóng yáo zhǐ xìng huā cūn
literal: may I ask · tavern · where · is, cowherd · from afar · points · apricot · blossom · village
natural: May I ask where there is a tavern? The cowherd points far off to Apricot Blossom Village

meaning.en: A traveller's search for wine on a rainy Qingming; quoted for Qingming festival and for asking directions.
meaning.zh: 清明时节旅人问路找酒家，牧童遥指杏花村，常用于清明或形容问路。

equivalents: where's the nearest tavern?
apricot blossoms at Qingming

examples.zh: 清明节出游，路上我们念起“借问酒家何处有，牧童遥指杏花村”。
examples.en: On our Qingming outing we recited '借问酒家何处有，牧童遥指杏花村' on the road.

examples.zh: 白酒厂把“借问酒家何处有，牧童遥指杏花村”印在酒瓶上。
examples.en: The distillery printed '借问酒家何处有，牧童遥指杏花村' on its bottle.

story.en: The quatrain opens with 'On Qingming the rain falls thick and fast, and the traveller on the road is heart-broken'; these are its closing lines.
story.zh: 全诗首句为“清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂”，此为末二句。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星
pinyin: tiān jiē yè sè liáng rú shuǐ, wò kàn qiān niú zhī nǚ xīng
literal: heaven's · steps · night · colour · cool · like · water, lying · watch · Cowherd · Weaver Girl · stars
natural: The marble steps lie in night as cool as water; I lie back and watch the Cowherd and Weaver Girl stars

meaning.en: A quiet summer night scene, with a hint of loneliness and longing; quoted for stargazing and Qixi (Chinese Valentine's Day). Some editions read 坐看 'sit and watch'.
meaning.zh: 凉夜里静看牛郎织女星，带着寂寥与向往，常在七夕或观星时引用。有些版本作“坐看”。

equivalents: watching the Cowherd and Weaver Girl stars
a cool summer night under the stars

examples.zh: 七夕夜，他们躺在草地上念着“天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星”。
examples.en: On Qixi they lay on the grass reciting '天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星'.

examples.zh: 夏夜露营，“天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星”的意境扑面而来。
examples.en: Camping on a summer night, the mood of '天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星' comes right at you.

story.en: A quatrain on an autumn night, usually read as describing a palace lady's loneliness (also attributed to Wang Jian in some collections).
story.zh: 一首写秋夜的绝句，多解为宫女的孤寂（部分选本题作王建）。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 秦人不暇自哀，而后人哀之；后人哀之而不鉴之，亦使后人而复哀后人也
pinyin: qín rén bù xiá zì āi, ér hòu rén āi zhī, hòu rén āi zhī ér bù jiàn zhī, yì shǐ hòu rén ér fù āi hòu rén yě
literal: Qin · people · not · have time · to mourn · themselves, and · later · people · mourn · them; later · people · mourn · them · but · not · take warning from · them, also · cause · later · people · again · mourn · later · people · [particle]
natural: The people of Qin had no time to mourn themselves, so later generations mourned for them; if later generations mourn them without learning from them, then yet later generations will mourn those who came after

meaning.en: A warning that history repeats itself if its lessons are not learned; quoted in discussions of historical lessons.
meaning.zh: 历史的教训若不吸取，后人也会重蹈覆辙，常用于谈以史为鉴。

equivalents: those who ignore history are doomed to repeat it
learn from the past

examples.zh: 历史课上，老师引用“秦人不暇自哀，而后人哀之；后人哀之而不鉴之，亦使后人而复哀后人也”。
examples.en: In history class the teacher quoted '秦人不暇自哀，而后人哀之；后人哀之而不鉴之，亦使后人而复哀后人也'.

examples.zh: 评论员以“秦人不暇自哀，而后人哀之；后人哀之而不鉴之，亦使后人而复哀后人也”提醒人们以史为鉴。
examples.en: The commentator used '秦人不暇自哀，而后人哀之；后人哀之而不鉴之，亦使后人而复哀后人也' to remind people to learn from history.

story.en: The final lines of Du Mu's 'Ode to the A-Fang Palace', written to warn the Tang rulers against the extravagance that doomed Qin.
story.zh: 杜牧《阿房宫赋》的结尾，借秦亡讽谏唐朝统治者勿骄奢。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 男儿何不带吴钩，收取关山五十州
pinyin: nán ér hé bù dài wú gōu, shōu qǔ guān shān wǔ shí zhōu
literal: man · why · not · wear · Wu · sabre, take back · passes · mountains · fifty · prefectures
natural: Why should a man not wear a Wu sabre and win back the fifty prefectures beyond the passes?

meaning.en: A young man's call to take up arms for his country; quoted for ambition and patriotic zeal.
meaning.zh: 男儿当从戎报国、收复失地，常用来表达建功立业的抱负和爱国热情。

equivalents: why not take up the sword for the nation?
a young man's call to arms

examples.zh: 青年时他立志参军，念着“男儿何不带吴钩，收取关山五十州”。
examples.en: In his youth he resolved to join the army, reciting '男儿何不带吴钩，收取关山五十州'.

examples.zh: 毕业宣言引用“男儿何不带吴钩，收取关山五十州”，豪情万丈。
examples.en: The graduation manifesto quoted '男儿何不带吴钩，收取关山五十州', full of fervour.

story.en: A poem by Li He (13 poems in the series 'South Garden'), expressing his wish for military achievement against rebel provinces.
story.zh: 李贺《南园十三首》之五，抒发从军报国、平定藩镇的愿望。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 日暮乡关何处是，烟波江上使人愁
pinyin: rì mù xiāng guān hé chù shì, yān bō jiāng shàng shǐ rén chóu
literal: sun · dusk · home · pass · where · is, misty · waves · river · on · makes · people · sorrow
natural: At sunset, where is my homeland? The misty waves on the river fill me with sorrow

meaning.en: Homesickness at dusk, with home lost in the mist; quoted for nostalgia.
meaning.zh: 黄昏时思念故乡而不见，常用来表达乡愁。

equivalents: where is home as the sun sets?
homesick at dusk

examples.zh: 海外游子读“日暮乡关何处是，烟波江上使人愁”，倍感思乡。
examples.en: Wanderers abroad read '日暮乡关何处是，烟波江上使人愁' and feel doubly homesick.

examples.zh: 春运海报写着“日暮乡关何处是，烟波江上使人愁”。
examples.en: The Spring Festival travel poster reads '日暮乡关何处是，烟波江上使人愁'.

story.en: Cui Hao's regulated verse on Yellow Crane Tower; Li Bai is said to have laid down his brush in admiration when he saw it there.
story.zh: 崔颢题黄鹤楼诗；相传李白见之搁笔，叹“眼前有景道不得，崔颢题诗在上头”。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。
